jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Commercial Project Manager (f/m/d), you will act as the financial co-pilot for steam turbine and generator projects, partnering closely with Order Managers and cross-functional teams throughout the entire project lifecycle. Your day will involve managing project controlling activities, analyzing financial performance, preparing forecasts and reports, and ensuring transparency across costs, risks, and opportunities. By leveraging your analytical mindset and digital affinity, you will contribute to efficient project execution and support strategic decision-making in an international and collaborative environment. Weekly presence in Mülheim and der Ruhr Office is expected.

How You’ll Make an Impact 
* Drive the financial success of steam turbine and generator projects by managing project controlling, forecasting, budgeting, and commercial order execution activities. 
* Act as the key commercial business partner to Order Managers and project execution teams, supporting commercial decision-making and claim management activities. 
* Prepare and support the planning and reporting of key business figures as baseline for management decisions
* Ensure accuracy and transparency of project financial data, bookings, and cost structures within SAP and related systems.
* You contribute to the continuous optimization of tools and processes by leveraging modern digitalization solutions.

What You Bring
* Bachelor / MBA Degree in Business Administration, Finance, or a comparable commercial qualification with relevant further training. 
* Long-term experience in commercial project management, controlling, or finance within an international plant engineering or manufacturing environment. 
* Strong knowledge of project controlling, financial forecasting, reporting standards, and financial regulations such as IFRS and HGB. 
* Advanced knowledge of SAP S/4HANA modules (FI/CO, SD, PS) and MS Office applications, as well as working experience in data analytics and visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, Snowflake, Alteryx)
* Analytical, proactive, and structured working style
* Business fluent German and English skills, combined with strong communication and stakeholder management capabilities in complex matrix organizations.

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 
* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programs and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

OVERVIEW:

Fairtrade is the most recognized and trusted sustainability label, working to make trade fairer for people and planet.

For more than three decades, Fairtrade has been making an impact on the way trade works. We believe that every farmer and worker should have access to a better way of doing business, and a better way of living. 

 Fairtrade International is an independent non-profit organisation representing more than two million small-scale farmers and workers worldwide. It owns the FAIRTRADE Mark, a registered trademark that appears on more than 37,000 products. Beyond certification, Fairtrade International and its member organisations (three producer networks and 19 national Fairtrade organisations) partner with producers and businesses, engage consumers, and advocate for a fair and sustainable future.

Unit’s description and purpose:

The Global Advocacy unit leads Fairtrade International's policy and citizen engagement efforts, supporting the "Inspire a collective commitment to fair and sustainable trade" pillar of the 2026–2028 Global Strategy. It amplifies the voices of farmers and workers, informs and influences policy, and builds partnerships that strengthen representation and equity in sustainable supply chains — positioning Fairtrade as a leading, coherent voice in sustainable trade at EU, global, and local levels.

Role purpose:

The Global Advocacy Lead guides Fairtrade International's advocacy work and directly manages the Global Advocacy team, supporting the wider Fairtrade system's efforts to multiply impact through proven producer-driven solutions that deliver policy and practice change for smallholder farmers and workers globally.

Following a recent review of Fairtrade's advocacy work, the post holder works closely with the Fairtrade Advocacy Community of Practice — the three producer networks, 19 national organisations, and the Fair Trade Advocacy Office (FTAO) — to reshape advocacy output and build on existing successes. Given Fairtrade's lean global centre and inter-dependent structure, the role's focus is on directly managing the Global Advocacy team while providing leadership, coherence, and a unified advocacy output.

PRINCIPAL ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Leadership and Global Coherence — approx. 35%

- Lead a coordinated EU/global/local advocacy programme centred on farmer and worker voices.
- Align producer networks, national organisations, and the FTAO via the Advocacy Community of Practice.
- Produce policy briefs to build thought leadership on priority topics.

Policy and Representation — approx. 35%

- Lead Fairtrade's global advocacy presence, monitoring EU/multilateral policy and influencing decision-makers with key partners.
- Represent Fairtrade at high-level fora and support other senior advocates.
- Turn policy analysis into advocacy actions that improve outcomes for farmers and workers.
- Advance Fair Trade Towns and embed Fairtrade principles into local procurement.
- Strengthen national-global advocacy links and producer network capacity.
- Sign off Fairtrade-wide advocacy positions, escalating high-risk cases to leadership.
- Build external coalitions with peers, multilaterals, and private sector actors.

Best Practice and Skill Development — approx. 10%

- Lead a capacity-building programme embedding strong advocacy practice system-wide.
- Work with producer networks and national organisations to accelerate regional advocacy.
- Develop measures to track advocacy impact.

Team Management and Relationships — approx. 20%

- Manage and develop the Global Advocacy team, setting priorities and ways of working.
- Support the Advocacy Community of Practice and its focal points.
- Partner with impact and programme teams to embed advocacy and source evidence for policy positions.
- Partner with communications for integrated advocacy work and represent advocacy in leadership forums.

Other tasks consistent with the level and responsibilities of this post

SKILLS REQUIRED:

Education & Experience

Postgraduate degree (or equivalent) in a relevant field. 7+ years senior advocacy leadership experience, with people-management background, ideally in a decentralised structure.

Language

Fluent English with excellent written communication skills. Proficiency in a second language (e.g., French or Spanish) is desired.

Job-Specific Knowledge

- Strong grasp of EU/multilateral institutions and how to influence them on trade and producer-rights policy.
- Experience building advocacy strategies combining lobbying, research, media, and campaigning.
- Advanced knowledge of sustainable trade and development issues; HREDD/climate/agriculture expertise a plus.
- Proven experience representing complex issues to high-level decision-makers and media.
- Producer-country experience is desirable.

Personal Qualities

- Bridge-builder with strong people and project-management skills.
- Balances vision, strategy, and pragmatism.
- Skilled in mediation, consensus-building, and cross-cultural collaboration.
- Well-organised, able to manage multiple priorities under pressure.
- Committed to gender, diversity, and producer inclusion.

Software / Tools

•      MS 365, Kobo Toolbox, Miro, Claude.ai (or equivalents)

TERMS AND CONDITIONS:

- This is a full-time position within Fairtrade International
- Location is at Fairtrade International offices in Bonn, Germany with the opportunity for hybrid work arrangements 
- The office language is English.
- Salary commensurate with competencies and qualifications, starting at 95,000 Euros gross per year  
- 30 days of holidays per year (for fulltime employees)
- Subsidised public transportation ticket 
- Subsidised meal services 
- Childcare cost subsidy 

Please note that Fairtrade International is strict on compliance with the required qualification criteria mentioned above, and only those candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.

Company Description

At METRO, we’re more than a global food wholesaler. We are ONE METRO: a diverse team of over 85,000 colleagues across more than 30 countries, united by one mission: enabling our 15 million customers to create meaningful moments in hospitality and independent trade.

We shape the M with passion, commitment, and growth mindset. This means taking on responsibility, making our company your company and creating a business together that remains true to its roots but always seeks new solutions.

Job Description

Your new role:

In the global headquarters we source a selection of goods that are offered to and sold by all our country subsidiaries worldwide. For our Food category, we are currently looking for an Expert in Global Procurement Food, limited for 24 months (all genders), who brings our assortment to the next level. You analyze the international assortment, align with the sourcing teams in our countries, and derive creative and beneficial solutions. You keep close track on supplier production capacity and coverage rate and check e-sourcing status and report database (prices, volumes, supplier contracts). Lead the global relationship between international teams of strategic suppliers, Metro HQ stakeholders and various METRO country companies ensuring the suppliers perform in line with our company strategy.

Where your expertise is needed:

- Performance: Define, develop, negotiate, implement, and review the performance of a Global Own Brand Range in our countries.
- Harmonization: Continuously align with our country subsidiaries to harmonize the product range and maximize its potential.
- Process-Management: Coordinate global cross functional teams (Quality, Packaging, Supply Chain, Marketing) through a clear and pre-defined Own Brand process.
- Negotiation: Analyze and compare RFQ inputs from suppliers to negotiate the best quality/price ratio.
- Strategy: Negotiate global service contracts delivering conditions against services designed together with our country’s international supplier strategies and joint business plans.

Qualifications

What we are looking for:

- Education: University degree (or equivalent experience) with minimum 2 years relevant work experience, preferably in buying food commodities / FMCG on an international level.
- Expertise & Personality: A strong negotiator with a proven track record in category management and condition-based supplier negotiations on both local and international level and strong interest in food product development and good understanding / willingness to learn HoReCa customer needs as well as openness to be motivated to get to know the B2B Food Wholesale sector, willing to accompany the development of our Global Strategy, following our Fundamentals with problem solving capacity and analytical thinking skills.
- Digital skills: Proficient knowledge of MS Office products including Word, Outlook and strong knowledge in Excel.
- Communication: Good communicator, who enjoys working in teams with internal colleagues from both HQ and countries, suppliers and manufacturer being fluent in English (both written and oral).
- Flexibility: Problem solving capacity and analytical thinking skills.

Additional Information

What we offer:

- Work-life balance: Flexible working hours in agreement with your line manager, 30 days of holiday.
- Training: A comprehensive training offer via our own training center or externally.
- Well-being: Health days with lots of health checks and information about your well-being, company medical care including a range of preventive services, such as flu shots, OTHEB employee assistance program.
- Exciting life on campus: Free gym and sports classes, Rioba coffee bar, canteen with discounted meals for employees, many campus events.
- Discounts: discounted Jobticket as well as discounts in our wholesale stores and at many partner companies.
- Comfort: Good transport connections, free parking spaces, JobBike.
- Company pension plan: You will receive a contribution to your company pension.
- Family driven: Three daycare centers for children on campus, support of holiday camps for children of employees.

jobs.occupation: Legal Counsel - Employment and Works constitution law - Germany CEE (f/m/x) (Syndikus-Anwalt/-Anwältin)
jobs.description:
The opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Legal Counsel – Employment & Labor Law (f/m/x) to lead our Social Affairs function across Germany & CEE (Austria, Romania and Czech Republic). Based in Germany, in this strategic role, you will be the architect of our social dialogue for Germany, Austria, Romania and Czech Republic. You will not only provide expert legal advice but also lead direct relationships with Employee Representatives and Works Councils in all four countries. You are responsible for negotiating agreements, ensuring compliance, and fostering a constructive social climate to support the Group’s transformation and growth in the region.

Day-to-day responsibilities

Regional Social Dialogue (DE, AT, RO, CZ)

- Germany (Betriebsrat): Lead negotiations on complex shop agreements (Betriebsvereinbarungen) regarding IT systems, mobile work, and restructuring. Manage co-determinationrights (Mitbestimmung) effectively.
- Austria (Betriebsrat): Lead the relationship with the Austrian Works Council. Navigate the specificities of the Austrian "Social Partnership" and negotiate local shop agreements in compliance with the Arbeitsverfassungsgesetz (ArbVG).
- Romania (Reprezentanții salariaților) and Czech Republic (Odborová organizace): Lead the relationship with the Works Councils.
- Harmonization: Ensure a consistent social strategy across Germany & CEE cluster while respecting local legislative nuances.

Employment Law Advisory

Legal Business Partner: Serve as the primary legal advisor to the HR Country 

- Individual Labor Law: Manage complex individual cases across the region: drafting termination notices, negotiating mutual separation agreements (Aufhebungsverträge / Mutual Termination Agreements), and handling disciplinary measures.
- Contracts: Maintain and update standard employment contract templates for Germany, Austria, Romania and Czech Republic to ensure they remain compliant with the latest local case law.

Restructuring & Strategic Projects

- Transformation Support: Legally structure and execute organizational changes across the region (e.g.,§613a BGB transfers in Germany, AVRAG transfers in Austria).
- Compliance: Roll out Group compliance policies (GDPR, Whistleblowing, Code of Conduct) ensuring they meet the strict data privacy standards of Germany and the specific requirements of the Austrian market.

Litigation Management

- Dispute Resolution: Represent the company in labor court proceedings (Kündigungsschutzklagen) in Germany.
- External Supervision: Select and manage external legal counsel in Austria, Romania and Czech Republic for specific litigation or high-risk cases, ensuring cost control and alignment with Group strategy.

Who are we looking for

Experience & Qualifications

- 8 to 10+ years of experience in Labor Law/Social Affairs, preferably within an international matrix organization, an IT/Consulting firm, or a specialized law firm.
- Works Council Leadership: Mandatory experience leading negotiations with Works Councils.
- You must have deep expertise in the German Betriebsverfassungsgesetz.
- You must have experience or a strong capability to manage Austrian employee representation bodies.
- Regional Scope: Proven ability to manage legal topics across multiple jurisdictions (Germany, Austria, Romania and Czech Republic).

Competencies

- Negotiation Skills: Ability to lead social dialogue in four different legal environments (example: co-determination of Germany).
- Pragmatism: Solution-oriented mindset; you enable business while managing risk.
- Languages: German (Native level) and English (Fluent) are required. French is a plus.

Perks & Benefits

- Regional Responsibility: A key role covering four distinct countries with strategic importance.
- Autonomy: You will be the lead expert for the region Germany, Austria, Romania and Czech Republic, trusted to handle sensitive negotiations with the collaboration of the HR Country Manager.
- Transformation: The opportunity to accompany a high-growth group in structuring its social foundations in the German & CEE market.

jobs.description:
Postdoctoral researcher (m/f/d) – Medical Department for Hematology, Oncology, and Cell Therapy Magdeburg Center for Cell and Immune Therapy

Third-party funding

The Faculty of Medicine of Otto von Guericke University Magdeburg, in close collaboration with the University Hospital Magdeburg, is a leading center for translational biomedical research in Germany. Major research priorities include Immunology, Cell and Immunotherapy, and Neurosciences.

We are seeking an outstanding and highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher (m/f/d) to join our internationally active research program in immune metabolism, hematopoietic stem cell transplantation, and next-generation cellular immunotherapies.

Our group combines cutting-edge basic immunology with investigator-initiated clinical trials in allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation and CAR-T cell therapy. Through close integration of laboratory and clinical research, we aim to translate mechanistic discoveries into innovative immunotherapeutic strategies for patients with hematological malignancies and immune-mediated diseases.

Our research has been published in leading international journals including The Lancet, The Lancet Neurology, Blood, Journal of Hepatology, and Journal of Hematology and Oncology. We are looking for ambitious scientists who aspire to perform research at the highest international level and pursue an academic career.

The successful candidate will become part of the Magdeburg Center for Cell and Immune Therapy (MAzI), an interdisciplinary research platform integrating basic science, translational immunology, GMP manufacturing, and investigator-initiated clinical trials in cellular immunotherapy.

Research Project

The position is embedded within the Collaborative Research Center/Transregio SFB/TRR 221 and focuses on mechanisms of immune regulation and tolerance following allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation, with translational extensions toward antigen-specific cellular therapies such as CAR-T cells.

A particular emphasis is placed on understanding how metabolic programming regulates T-cell fitness, persistence, and exhaustion and how these pathways can be therapeutically targeted to improve transplantation outcomes and next-generation cellular immunotherapies.

We offer:

- an internationally visible translational research program
- participation in innovative, high-impact research projects
- close interaction with clinician scientists and access to unique patient cohorts
- state-of-the-art technologies-
- a vibrant interdisciplinary research environment
- opportunities for national and international collaborations
- strong support for scientific independence and career development
- a family-friendly and supportive working environment

Living in Magdeburg:

- Magdeburg offers affordable housing, excellent research infrastructure, a high quality of life, and excellent transport connections to Berlin and other major German cities.

Your Responsibilities:

- design and lead an independent translational research project
- actively participate in the scientific development of MAZI
- contribute to the supervision of MSc, MD, and PhD students
- collaborate with national and international research partners
- present research findings at international conferences
- publish results in leading peer-reviewed journals
- contribute to grant applications and collaborative research initiatives

Your Profile:

- PhD in Immunology, Molecular Medicine, Biology, Biochemistry, or a related discipline
- excellent publication record, including at least two first-author (or shared first-author) original research articles in international peer-reviewed journals. Applicants with publications in leading journals will be particularly encouraged to apply.
- strong background in one or more of the following fields: Tumor immunology | Cellular immunotherapy | Immune metabolism | T-cell biology | Gene editing | Stem cell transplantation
- experience with murine models is highly desirable (FELASA B/C certification is an advantage)
- excellent written and spoken English (German language skills are not required)
- we particularly encourage applications from scientists with a strong commitment to scientific excellence and the ambition to establish an independent academic career.

The Opportunity 

You will be part of a highly flexible development team for the MeTS Hardware Security Modules with members in Brussels, Aachen and abroad, so good communication skills are essential. The Software Architect and Project Manager for the MeTS HSM is responsible for designing the embedded application software of the Hardware Security Module (HSM). This role requires expertise in embedded programming, a strong background in C and experience with applied cryptography and cryptographic primitives.  
This role is as another aspect also responsible for the close management and coordination of an offshore development team from our German office, ensuring the quality, consistency and timely delivery of the system software for the Hardware Security Module (HSM). This requires hands-on technical involvement — including systematic source code reviews, creation and validation of cryptographic test vectors, and architectural guidance — combined with strong project management discipline. 

Day-to-Day Responsibilities 

Managing and steering an offshore development team to deliver security products in embedded systems for financial transactions, smart grid, eHealth and others. Overseeing the definition, analysis, development and validation of security-related applications on a Hardware Security Module, with direct technical involvement in code quality, testing and architecture. Help developing the architecture of security products in embedded systems for financial transactions, smart grid, eHealth and others. Defining, analyzing, developing and validating security-related applications on a Hardware Security Module.

Key Responsibilities:

- System Design: Develop and maintain the architecture for the system software of the MeTS HSMs ADYTON and ASM.
- Technical and Project Leadership: Guide and support in-house and offshore development teams in best practices for implementing the HSM software.  
- Agile Development: Collaborate with cross-functional teams in an agile environment, participating in sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives. 
- Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with the Product Owner and Product Manager to gather requirements, prioritize features, and translate them into technical specifications. 
- Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation of interface designs, and security measures specific to the MeTS HSMs. 
- Quality Assurance: Ensure that software solutions adhere to industry standards for security and performance. 
- Problem Solving: Identify and resolve technical challenges related to MeTS HSM integration. 
- You are a technical leader able to lead and guide off-shore and in-house teams in architecture, analysis and developments for made-to-measure customer solutions.
- You have a strong background in C, it would be apricated if you have a good knowledge in C++ and Java. The team work in an agile environment with a high demand of independent, autonomously and pro-active way to structure tasks and solve issues.
- The ideal candidate should possess proficiency in C programming and embedded systems development, along with a strong understanding of cryptography.
- Experience with secure coding practices and security standards is essential.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills are also required to effectively collaborate with team members and stakeholders. 

These qualities are essential! We’re also looking for the following skills and experience:

- Specialist in computer science with a related university degree 
- Proven experience managing offshore or distributed development teams with close technical oversight 
- Strong aptitude for analysis, a results-oriented worker capable of finding creative solutions 
- Excellent team player with the ability to build trust and maintain productivity across cultural and geographical boundaries 
- Outstanding communication skills, and a good command of spoken and written English 
- Awareness of a range of development support tools 
- Quick adaptation to new technologies 

Who Are We Looking For 

We look for big thinkers. People who can drive positive change, step up and show what’s next – people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. In practice this means: 

- Experience with embedded systems and C development 
- Proven ability to conduct meaningful source code reviews in C, identifying defects, security vulnerabilities and optimization opportunities 
- Experience creating and validating cryptographic test vectors for algorithm verification and compliance testing 
- Strong architectural knowledge of embedded systems and Hardware Security Modules 
- Knowledge of testing methodology (unit, integration, white/black box testing …) 
- Good knowledge of security standards like PCI PIN, PCI PTS HSM, ANSI X9.143 (TR31), ASC X9 TR34, EMVCo and similar
- Solid background in security (hardware and/or software), cryptographic algorithms and primitives and applied cryptography 
- Knowledge of OpenSSL and ASN.1 is a plus  
- German language proficiency is a plus 
- PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent project management certification is a plus

Global Commodity Manager Valves & Actuators

Job Title  Corporate Commodity Manager (f/m/d) Valves & Actuators Location: Germany, Sweden, US Department: SE P DM SYS RA Job Grade: Germany - Non Senior Management ÜT-Kreis Mode of Employment: Full-time / Permanent A Snapshot of Your Day  The organization Strategic Procurement, Direct Material is responsible for developing and implementing procurement strategies for direct materials and services that will ensure the optimization of Siemens Energy’s competitive position. As a Corporate Commodity Manager for Valves & Actuators, you will be part of Corporate Strategic Procurement team (SE P DM SYS RA), lead a cross-functional team globally and are responsible for a Corporate commodity strategy. Focus is on developing and managing a Valves & Actuator suppliers Typical day for Corporate Commodity Manager includes define/execution of commodity strategies, negotiation with suppliers, supplier relationship management, supplier contract management, reporting, problem solving and escalation handling, supply chain risk mitigation as well as alignment meetings with internal/external x-functional team. How You’ll Make an Impact  The successful candidate will be the Corporate Commodity Manager for Valves & Actuators, which includes: Manage commodity globally and across organizations and develop, implement, and maintain a global commodity strategy for Valves & Actuators, in alignment with business units. Conduct market analysis, cost structure analysis, and supply landscape evaluations. Identify cost‑saving opportunities, to include innovation pathways Maintain a strong external network of Valve & Actuator OEM’s, which include new supplier development. Identify, evaluate, and approve strategic suppliers based on capability, sustainability, quality, and cost. Build long‑term supplier relationships and lead supplier business reviews, scorecard evaluations, and follow-up actions. Ensure business continuity by preparing risk mitigation plans and dual/multi sourcing concepts. Internal and external management around demand vs supply in terms of capacity management. Internal and external management around market intelligence, which includes but is not limited to Market trends (cost drivers, M&A, demand). Geopolitical and supply chain risk impact, competitor and supplier landscape. Prepare and run quarterly business reviews / executive alignment Lead complex commercial negotiations, including pricing, terms, capacity and service agreements and manage framework contracts, SLAs, pricing and supply agreements. Ensure suppliers meet environmental, social, and governance (ESG) standards. Be strong interface to lead commodity circles with R&D, Cost-Value Engineering, Supplier Quality Development as well as other procurement functions. What You Bring Degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Packaging Technology, or a related field. 5–10 years’ experience in strategic procurement, preferably in Direct Materials in Energy, Oil & Gas, Process Industry. Packaging experience is strongly preferred. Strong commercial and negotiation skills. Knowledge in supply and supplier markets for Valves & Actuators. Operations experience (Manufacturing and SCM), ideally in a leadership position are a plus Excellent analytical capabilities and structured problem-solving. Strong stakeholder management capabilities across functions and regions. Ability to integrate and influence in a matrix organization and drive corporate initiatives Excellent knowledge of contract law and export control Knowledge in geo-political cost management strategies Fluent English; German and other languages are a plus Position is posted for Germany, Sweden, US Travel percentage ~25%   About the Team The SE P DM SYS RA organization is responsible for managing 3rd party spend as well as developing procurement strategies of direct material fields for Rotating Equipment and Auxiliaries that will allow Siemens Energy to maintain competitive position in marketplace and support company’s vision to become the most valued energy technology company Our professional procurement team utilizes modern tools and processes to develop global sourcing strategy for assigned commodities, that delivers optimal supply cost, quality, on time delivery, ESG (Environment, Social & Governance) compliant and VUCA resilient supply chain for Business Unit to improve competitive advantage for Siemens Energy.
